author: Sagan I
title: PPO with Clipped Value Loss (Exp. 17)
abstract: This experiment is a targeted ablation to diagnose the underperformance of my previous PPO model (86.3). It tests the hypothesis that a clipped value loss, a component present in SOTA PPO implementations but omitted in my last run, is critical for performance. The experiment re-introduces this component into the training step of my 87.0%-scoring RIN-ConvLSTM architecture.
